# Purpose

This file performs the planned **2026 external validation** using surveillance data that were
not included in the 2016-2025 analytic window.

Primary aims:

1. score the paper's fixed 2024-2025 municipality priority rankings against observed 2026
   confirmed cases and deaths;
2. summarize the age distribution of observed 2026 deaths relative to the Brazilian IXCHIQ
   18-59 age window;
3. inspect Dourados and the named 2026 pilot municipalities against the pre-2026 rankings;
4. optionally compare the pilot municipalities with the existing 2025 rolling-origin forecast
   ranking if that prediction file is present.

This is external corroboration using a **partial/provisional 2026 surveillance file**. It is not
a completed full-year analysis. Re-pull the 2026 source immediately before manuscript submission.

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE, warning = TRUE, message = TRUE)

source("00_setup.R")

EXPECTED_N_MUNI <- 5570L
TOP_N <- ceiling(EXPECTED_N_MUNI / 3)

RESULT_ROOT <- RESULTS_DIR
OUT_DIR <- file.path(RESULT_ROOT, "external_validation_2026")
dir.create(OUT_DIR, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

# Current fixed 2024-2025 rule evaluation produced by File 13.
PRIORITY_PATH <- file.path(
  RESULT_ROOT,
  "priority_rule_evaluation_municipality_2024_2025.csv"
)

# Existing one-year-ahead 2025 rolling-origin prediction produced by File 14.
# This is a through-2024 forecast for 2025; it is NOT a through-2025 forecast for 2026.
ROLLING_2025_PATH <- file.path(
  RESULT_ROOT,
  "rolling_origin",
  "predictions",
  "forecast_annual_predict_2025.csv"
)

# Raw 2026 DBC used only for external validation.
CHIK26_PATH <- file.path(CHIK_DATA_DIR, "CHIKBR26.dbc")

cat("Top-third municipality count:", TOP_N, "\n")
cat("Priority ranking:", PRIORITY_PATH, "\n")
cat("2026 DBC:", CHIK26_PATH, "\n")
```

# 1. Load fixed pre-2026 rankings

```{r load-rankings}
if (!file.exists(PRIORITY_PATH)) {
  stop(
    "Missing File 13 output:\n", PRIORITY_PATH,
    "\nRun File 13 or restore the saved output before File 18."
  )
}

priority_2425 <- readr::read_csv(
  PRIORITY_PATH,
  show_col_types = FALSE,
  col_types = cols(
    code_muni = col_character(),
    .default = col_guess()
  )
) %>%
  mutate(
    code_muni = stringr::str_pad(
      substr(as.character(code_muni), 1, 6),
      width = 6, side = "left", pad = "0"
    )
  )

required_priority_cols <- c(
  "code_muni", "T_irr", "V_burden", "combined_burden"
)

stopifnot(
  all(required_priority_cols %in% names(priority_2425)),
  nrow(priority_2425) == EXPECTED_N_MUNI,
  dplyr::n_distinct(priority_2425$code_muni) == EXPECTED_N_MUNI
)

cat("Fixed pre-2026 ranking municipalities:", nrow(priority_2425), "\n")
```

# 2. Load the 2026 surveillance file separately

The 2026 file is never bound into `Chik_total`.

If `Chik_2026` already exists in the current R session, it is reused. Otherwise only
`CHIKBR26.dbc` is read; there is no need to rerun the entire 2016-2025 import notebook.

```{r load-2026}
if (!exists("Chik_2026")) {
  if (!file.exists(CHIK26_PATH)) {
    stop(
      "CHIKBR26.dbc not found at:\n", CHIK26_PATH,
      "\nCheck RAW_DBC_DIR in 00_setup.R."
    )
  }

  Chik_2026 <- read.dbc::read.dbc(CHIK26_PATH) %>%
    mutate(DT_SIN_PRI = as.Date(DT_SIN_PRI))
} else {
  Chik_2026 <- Chik_2026 %>%
    mutate(DT_SIN_PRI = as.Date(DT_SIN_PRI))
}

cat("Raw 2026 notifications:", nrow(Chik_2026), "\n")
cat(
  "Latest non-missing notification date in local 2026 file:",
  as.character(max(Chik_2026$DT_SIN_PRI, na.rm = TRUE)),
  "\n"
)

# IMPORTANT: the date above is the latest notification date present in the local file,
# not necessarily the official extraction/download date.
```

# 3. Fixed municipality lookup

```{r municipality-lookup}
MUNI_PATH_CANDIDATES <- result_path("muni_sf_2020.rds")

muni_hit <- MUNI_PATH_CANDIDATES[file.exists(MUNI_PATH_CANDIDATES)]

if (length(muni_hit) > 0L) {
  muni_sf <- readRDS(muni_hit[1])
} else {
  # Same 2020 spatial reference used elsewhere in the revised pipeline.
  muni_sf <- geobr::read_municipality(year = 2020, showProgress = FALSE)
}

muni_lookup <- muni_sf %>%
  sf::st_drop_geometry() %>%
  mutate(
    code_muni = stringr::str_pad(
      substr(as.character(code_muni), 1, 6),
      width = 6, side = "left", pad = "0"
    )
  ) %>%
  select(
    code_muni,
    any_of(c(
      "name_muni", "code_state", "abbrev_state",
      "name_state", "code_region", "name_region"
    ))
  ) %>%
  distinct(code_muni, .keep_all = TRUE)

stopifnot(
  nrow(muni_lookup) == EXPECTED_N_MUNI,
  dplyr::n_distinct(muni_lookup$code_muni) == EXPECTED_N_MUNI
)
```

# 4. Construct confirmed 2026 external-validation outcomes

The established revised case definition is retained here:
`CLASSI_FIN %in% c(1, 13)`.

```{r construct-2026-outcomes}
decode_age_years_2026 <- function(x) {
  x <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(as.character(x)))
  unit_code <- floor(x / 1000)
  value <- x %% 1000

  dplyr::case_when(
    unit_code == 1 ~ value / (24 * 365),
    unit_code == 2 ~ value / 365,
    unit_code == 3 ~ value / 12,
    unit_code == 4 ~ value,
    TRUE ~ NA_real_
  )
}

chik26_confirmed <- Chik_2026 %>%
  mutate(
    code_muni = stringr::str_pad(
      substr(as.character(ID_MUNICIP), 1, 6),
      width = 6, side = "left", pad = "0"
    ),
    age_years = decode_age_years_2026(NU_IDADE_N),
    death = as.integer(as.character(EVOLUCAO) == "2")
  ) %>%
  filter(
    CLASSI_FIN %in% c(1, 13),
    !is.na(DT_SIN_PRI),
    DT_SIN_PRI >= as.Date("2026-01-01"),
    DT_SIN_PRI <= as.Date("2026-12-31"),
    code_muni %in% priority_2425$code_muni
  )

cat("Confirmed 2026 cases in fixed 5,570-municipality universe:",
    nrow(chik26_confirmed), "\n")
cat("Confirmed 2026 deaths:",
    sum(chik26_confirmed$death, na.rm = TRUE), "\n")

obs_2026 <- chik26_confirmed %>%
  group_by(code_muni) %>%
  summarise(
    cases_2026 = n(),
    deaths_2026 = sum(death, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

eval_2026 <- priority_2425 %>%
  select(
    code_muni,
    T_irr,
    V_burden,
    combined_burden
  ) %>%
  left_join(obs_2026, by = "code_muni") %>%
  mutate(
    cases_2026 = tidyr::replace_na(cases_2026, 0L),
    deaths_2026 = tidyr::replace_na(deaths_2026, 0L)
  ) %>%
  left_join(muni_lookup, by = "code_muni")

stopifnot(
  nrow(eval_2026) == EXPECTED_N_MUNI,
  sum(eval_2026$cases_2026) == nrow(chik26_confirmed),
  sum(eval_2026$deaths_2026) == sum(chik26_confirmed$death, na.rm = TRUE)
)
```

# 5. External validation at matched top-third coverage

The ranking is fixed before looking at 2026 outcomes. We score the same three rules used
in File 13:

1. transmission-only (`T_irr`);
2. age/severity-only (`V_burden`);
3. expected-burden (`combined_burden`).

```{r score-fixed-rankings}
rule_specs <- tibble::tribble(
  ~rule, ~score_col,
  "Transmission-only", "T_irr",
  "Age/severity-only", "V_burden",
  "Expected-burden", "combined_burden"
)

score_top_n_2026 <- function(dat, score_col, rule_name, n_select = TOP_N) {

  selected <- dat %>%
    arrange(desc(.data[[score_col]]), code_muni) %>%
    slice_head(n = n_select)

  total_cases <- sum(dat$cases_2026, na.rm = TRUE)
  total_deaths <- sum(dat$deaths_2026, na.rm = TRUE)

  tibble(
    rule = rule_name,
    n_selected = nrow(selected),
    municipality_coverage = nrow(selected) / nrow(dat),
    cases_captured = sum(selected$cases_2026, na.rm = TRUE),
    cases_total = total_cases,
    cases_capture_share = ifelse(
      total_cases > 0,
      sum(selected$cases_2026, na.rm = TRUE) / total_cases,
      NA_real_
    ),
    deaths_captured = sum(selected$deaths_2026, na.rm = TRUE),
    deaths_total = total_deaths,
    deaths_capture_share = ifelse(
      total_deaths > 0,
      sum(selected$deaths_2026, na.rm = TRUE) / total_deaths,
      NA_real_
    )
  )
}

external_validation_top_third <- purrr::map2_dfr(
  rule_specs$score_col,
  rule_specs$rule,
  ~ score_top_n_2026(eval_2026, .x, .y)
)

print(external_validation_top_third)
```

# 6. Municipality ranks and Dourados

```{r municipality-ranks}
ranked_2026 <- eval_2026 %>%
  mutate(
    rank_transmission = rank(-T_irr, ties.method = "min"),
    rank_age_severity = rank(-V_burden, ties.method = "min"),
    rank_expected_burden = rank(-combined_burden, ties.method = "min"),
    top_third_transmission = rank_transmission <= TOP_N,
    top_third_age_severity = rank_age_severity <= TOP_N,
    top_third_expected_burden = rank_expected_burden <= TOP_N
  )

normalize_name <- function(x) {
  x <- enc2utf8(as.character(x))
  x <- stringi::stri_trans_general(x, "Latin-ASCII")
  x <- toupper(trimws(x))
  x <- gsub("[^A-Z0-9 ]+", " ", x)
  x <- gsub("\\s+", " ", x)
  trimws(x)
}

if ("name_muni" %in% names(ranked_2026)) {

  dourados_result <- ranked_2026 %>%
    mutate(name_key = normalize_name(name_muni)) %>%
    filter(name_key == "DOURADOS") %>%
    select(
      code_muni,
      any_of(c("name_muni", "abbrev_state", "name_state")),
      cases_2026,
      deaths_2026,
      rank_transmission,
      rank_age_severity,
      rank_expected_burden,
      top_third_transmission,
      top_third_age_severity,
      top_third_expected_burden
    )

  cat("\nDourados external-validation row:\n")
  print(dourados_result)

} else {

  dourados_result <- tibble()
  warning("name_muni is unavailable; Dourados name-based lookup was skipped.")
}
```

# 7. Named 2026 pilot municipalities from the revision plan

This is the **named subset recorded in the revision plan**, not a claim that it is the
complete final Ministry pilot list. The official list should be re-checked before submission.

Four municipality names contain accented spellings that can be encoded inconsistently in
the 2020 municipality object. To avoid fragile string matching, the pilot table uses fixed
six-digit IBGE municipality codes for all 14 named municipalities.

```{r pilot-municipalities}
pilot_named <- tibble::tribble(
  ~name_plan, ~state_plan, ~code_muni,
  "Dourados", "MS", "500370",
  "Itapora", "MS", "500450",
  "Amambai", "MS", "500060",
  "Bataypora", "MS", "500200",
  "Douradina", "MS", "500350",
  "Sete Quedas", "MS", "500770",
  "Bady Bassitt", "SP", "350460",
  "Mirassol", "SP", "353030",
  "Simao Dias", "SE", "280710",
  "Barra dos Coqueiros", "SE", "280060",
  "Lagarto", "SE", "280350",
  "Santa Luzia", "MG", "315780",
  "Sabara", "MG", "315670",
  "Congonhas", "MG", "311800"
)

pilot_eval <- pilot_named %>%
  left_join(
    ranked_2026,
    by = "code_muni"
  ) %>%
  select(
    code_muni,
    name_plan,
    state_plan,
    any_of(c("name_muni", "abbrev_state", "name_state")),
    cases_2026,
    deaths_2026,
    rank_transmission,
    rank_age_severity,
    rank_expected_burden,
    top_third_transmission,
    top_third_age_severity,
    top_third_expected_burden
  ) %>%
  arrange(rank_expected_burden)

unmatched_pilot <- pilot_eval %>%
  filter(
    is.na(name_muni) |
      is.na(rank_expected_burden)
  )

if (nrow(unmatched_pilot) > 0L) {
  cat("\nUnmatched pilot municipalities after IBGE-code join:\n")
  print(unmatched_pilot %>% select(name_plan, state_plan, code_muni))
  stop("Pilot municipality matching is incomplete after IBGE-code join.")
}

cat("\nNamed pilot municipalities matched:",
    nrow(pilot_eval), "of", nrow(pilot_named), "\n")
print(pilot_eval)

stopifnot(
  nrow(pilot_eval) == 14L,
  dplyr::n_distinct(pilot_eval$code_muni) == 14L
)
```

# 8. Optional comparison with the existing 2025 rolling-origin forecast

The existing File 14 prediction for target year 2025 was generated using data available
before 2025. It can be used only as an additional **ranking** comparison.

**It must not be described as a model fitted through 2025 to predict 2026.**
The absolute `forecast_annual` values are not interpreted here; only their ordering is used.
A genuine through-2025 -> 2026 forecast would require a separate forecast fit.

```{r optional-rolling-ranking}
rolling_2025_available <- file.exists(ROLLING_2025_PATH)

if (rolling_2025_available) {

  rolling_2025 <- readr::read_csv(
    ROLLING_2025_PATH,
    show_col_types = FALSE,
    col_types = cols(
      code_muni = col_character(),
      .default = col_guess()
    )
  ) %>%
    mutate(
      code_muni = stringr::str_pad(
        substr(as.character(code_muni), 1, 6),
        width = 6, side = "left", pad = "0"
      )
    )

  stopifnot(
    nrow(rolling_2025) == EXPECTED_N_MUNI,
    "forecast_annual" %in% names(rolling_2025),
    all(is.finite(rolling_2025$forecast_annual))
  )

  eval_rolling_2025_vs_2026 <- eval_2026 %>%
    select(
      code_muni,
      cases_2026,
      deaths_2026,
      any_of(c("name_muni", "abbrev_state", "name_state"))
    ) %>%
    left_join(
      rolling_2025 %>% select(code_muni, forecast_annual),
      by = "code_muni"
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      rank_rolling_2025 = rank(-forecast_annual, ties.method = "min"),
      top_third_rolling_2025 = rank_rolling_2025 <= TOP_N
    )

  rolling_external_score <- score_top_n_2026(
    eval_rolling_2025_vs_2026,
    "forecast_annual",
    "Rolling-origin 2025 ranking"
  )

  print(rolling_external_score)

  if ("name_muni" %in% names(eval_rolling_2025_vs_2026)) {
    dourados_rolling <- eval_rolling_2025_vs_2026 %>%
      mutate(name_key = normalize_name(name_muni)) %>%
      filter(name_key == "DOURADOS") %>%
      select(
        code_muni,
        name_muni,
        abbrev_state,
        cases_2026,
        deaths_2026,
        rank_rolling_2025,
        top_third_rolling_2025
      )

    cat("\nDourados in existing 2025 rolling-origin ranking:\n")
    print(dourados_rolling)
  }

} else {
  cat(
    "Optional rolling-origin 2025 prediction not found; skipping this comparison:\n",
    ROLLING_2025_PATH, "\n"
  )
}
```

# 9. Age distribution of 2026 deaths

```{r age-distribution-deaths}
death_age_2026 <- chik26_confirmed %>%
  filter(death == 1L) %>%
  mutate(
    eligibility_age_band = case_when(
      is.na(age_years) ~ "Age missing/unknown",
      age_years < 18 ~ "<18",
      age_years >= 18 & age_years <= 59 ~ "18-59",
      age_years >= 60 ~ "60+",
      TRUE ~ "Age missing/unknown"
    ),
    eligibility_age_band = factor(
      eligibility_age_band,
      levels = c("<18", "18-59", "60+", "Age missing/unknown")
    )
  ) %>%
  count(eligibility_age_band, name = "deaths") %>%
  mutate(
    share_all_deaths = deaths / sum(deaths)
  )

print(death_age_2026)

known_age_deaths <- death_age_2026 %>%
  filter(eligibility_age_band != "Age missing/unknown") %>%
  summarise(n = sum(deaths)) %>%
  pull(n)

age_window_summary <- death_age_2026 %>%
  mutate(
    status = case_when(
      eligibility_age_band == "18-59" ~ "Inside 18-59 age window",
      eligibility_age_band %in% c("<18", "60+") ~ "Outside 18-59 age window",
      TRUE ~ "Age missing/unknown"
    )
  ) %>%
  group_by(status) %>%
  summarise(
    deaths = sum(deaths),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    share_all_deaths = deaths / sum(deaths),
    share_known_age_deaths = ifelse(
      status == "Age missing/unknown" | known_age_deaths == 0,
      NA_real_,
      deaths / known_age_deaths
    )
  )

cat("\n2026 death age-window summary:\n")
print(age_window_summary)
```

# 10. State-level 2026 descriptive table

```{r state-summary}
state_group_cols <- intersect(
  c("code_state", "abbrev_state", "name_state"),
  names(eval_2026)
)

if (length(state_group_cols) > 0L) {

  state_2026 <- eval_2026 %>%
    group_by(across(all_of(state_group_cols))) %>%
    summarise(
      cases_2026 = sum(cases_2026),
      deaths_2026 = sum(deaths_2026),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    arrange(desc(cases_2026))

  print(state_2026, n = Inf, width = Inf)

} else {
  state_2026 <- tibble()
  warning("State metadata unavailable; state summary skipped.")
}
```

# 11. Compact external-validation figure

```{r external-validation-figure, fig.width=7.4, fig.height=4.2}
plot_external <- external_validation_top_third %>%
  select(
    rule,
    cases_capture_share,
    deaths_capture_share
  ) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(cases_capture_share, deaths_capture_share),
    names_to = "outcome",
    values_to = "capture_share"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    outcome = recode(
      outcome,
      cases_capture_share = "Observed 2026 cases",
      deaths_capture_share = "Observed 2026 deaths"
    ),
    rule = factor(
      rule,
      levels = c(
        "Transmission-only",
        "Age/severity-only",
        "Expected-burden"
      )
    )
  )

p_external_2026 <- ggplot(
  plot_external,
  aes(x = rule, y = capture_share, shape = rule)
) +
  geom_hline(
    yintercept = TOP_N / EXPECTED_N_MUNI,
    linetype = "dotted",
    linewidth = 0.5
  ) +
  geom_point(size = 3) +
  facet_wrap(~ outcome, nrow = 1) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    labels = scales::percent_format(accuracy = 1),
    limits = c(0, 1)
  ) +
  labs(
    x = NULL,
    y = "Share captured"
  ) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 10) +
  theme(
    legend.position = "none",
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 25, hjust = 1)
  )

print(p_external_2026)
```

```{r final-checks}
    ),
```

```{r}
      rule,
      levels = c(
        "Transmission-only",
        "Age/severity-only",
        "Expected-burden"
      )
    )
  )


cols <- c(
  "Transmission-only" = "#D55E00",
  "Age/severity-only" = "#009E73",
  "Expected-burden" = "#0072B2"
)

p_external_clean <- ggplot(
  plot_external_bar,
  aes(
    x = capture,
    y = rule,
    fill = rule
  )
) +
  geom_col(
    width = 0.58,
    show.legend = FALSE
  ) +
  geom_text(
    aes(
      label = scales::percent(capture, accuracy = 0.1)
    ),
    hjust = -0.15,
    size = 3.5
  ) +
  facet_wrap(
    ~ outcome,
    nrow = 1
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = cols) +
  scale_x_continuous(
  labels = scales::percent_format(accuracy = 1),
  limits = c(0, 1.10),
  breaks = c(0, 0.25, 0.50, 0.75, 1.00),
  expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0))
) +
  labs(
    x = "Share of observed 2026 burden captured",
    y = NULL
  ) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 11) +
  theme(
    strip.background = element_blank(),
    strip.text = element_text(
      face = "bold",
      hjust = 0
    ),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 10),
    axis.title.x = element_text(margin = margin(t = 8)),
    panel.spacing = unit(1.2, "lines")
  )

p_external_clean

```


# Interpretation guardrails

- The 2026 data are partial/provisional surveillance data. Always state the actual file
  extraction/download date in the manuscript once confirmed. Do not substitute the latest
  notification date in the analytic subset for the extraction date.
- This is external corroboration, not a completed full-year 2026 estimate.
- Captured cases and deaths are observed notified outcomes; do not describe them as outcomes prevented.
- Do not infer vaccine effectiveness from municipality-level 2026 outcomes or from Dourados.
- The named pilot list in this file is the subset listed in the revision plan and should be
  checked against the final official Ministry list before submission.
- The optional `forecast_annual_predict_2025.csv` comparison is a through-2024 forecast for
  target year 2025. Do not call it a through-2025 prediction of 2026.
- A genuine through-2025 -> 2026 INLA forecast would be a separate model fit and is intentionally
  not substituted or implied by this file.
